groups.title: Groups
groups.lead: A group carries permissions. A person carries what their groups carry.
groups.new_lead: The slug is the stable name and does not change afterwards.
groups.empty_message: Nothing matches, or nothing has been created yet.

group.permissions_lead: Every permission this application declares. What is not ticked is not carried.
group.members_lead: One identifier per line. Removing everybody from a system group is refused.
group.delete_lead: The group, what it carries and who is in it, all at once.
group.delete_confirm: Delete this group and every membership on it?
group.system_title: This group holds the installation together
group.system_message: It cannot be deleted, its permissions cannot be taken off it, and it cannot be left without a member.

catalogue.title: Permissions
catalogue.lead: Every permission this application declares, and the groups that carry it.

member.title: Effective permissions
member.none: In no group, and therefore carrying nothing.
member.origin: Permissions, and where each comes from
member.empty_message: No group this person belongs to carries a permission, and nothing was given to them directly.
member.direct_lead: Given to this person and to nobody else. What their groups carry is above, and is not ticked here.
